تخاطبت (form VI)
# تَخَاطَبْتُ (taḵāṭabtu) /ta.xaː.tˤab.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَخَاطَبَ (taḵāṭaba)
# تَخَاطَبْتَ (taḵāṭabta) /ta.xaː.tˤab.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَخَاطَبَ (taḵāṭaba)
# تَخَاطَبْتِ (taḵāṭabti) /ta.xaː.tˤab.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَخَاطَبَ (taḵāṭaba)
# تَخَاطَبَتْ (taḵāṭabat) /ta.xaː.tˤa.bat/: third-person
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
